one_liner: Type "send 0.01 PHRS to 0x…" — the agent parses it into a plan, shows a review card, and only moves funds after approval.
what_it_does: Type a payment in plain English and this lamp turns it into a plan, shows you a review card with the exact recipient and amount, and only sends when you confirm. Ambiguous instructions are refused rather than guessed at. Proven by 2 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet plus 1 refused ambiguous request, all linked below.
